node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal branch coefficient compiler
node.closure: reciprocal quadratic-norm normal form for the source-line branch and split cubic-resolvent test for the biquadratic branch
node.statement: In the diagonal source-line branch, compatible coordinates give H=U+XV and G=U^2-WV^2, where U and V have bidegrees at most (2,2) and (2,1), obey one common reciprocal sign, and occupy source spaces of dimensions 8 and 7. The endpoint G is always positive reciprocal. In the non-lifting branch, the monic endpoint quartic over K(W) has a completely split cubic resolvent and square discriminant; for an irreducible separable quartic, resolvent splitting is equivalent to V4 Galois group. These are exact branch-deletion tests, not universal exclusions.
